# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes. Please upgrade before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Report privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/viicslen/gitura/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected version, steps to reproduce, and the impact you observed.
You should get a response within a week. Once a fix ships, the advisory is published
with credit to the reporter unless you ask otherwise.
